decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting system builds directly on the firm's strong specialist-lighting, standards-compliance and rugged-environment know-how, so early market presence is worth developing further through its existing engineering and testing base.

The spring-balanced desk lamp fits the firm's ergonomic and human-centric lighting direction and is close enough to its office-application expertise that the firm can readily learn from initial demand and refine it.

As a new generation of general interior luminaire presented prominently on its own page, this product is tightly aligned with the firm's core capabilities and strategic push in efficient mainstream building lighting.

A pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics sits squarely within the firm's established optical, application-specific and office-building lighting knowledge, making continued commercialization and incremental improvement attractive.

Although marine search is related to the firm's specialist expertise, an HMI-based searchlight is less consistent with its move toward more sustainable and intelligent lighting, and the weak market signal suggests limited learning payoff versus reallocating resources to newer platforms.

A marine searchlight remains well within the firm's absorptive capacity in robust transport and specialist lighting, and keeping it preserves a platform the firm can improve with its in-house engineering and marine application knowledge.
